instruction: In the opening safety paragraph directly below the subtitle, place one empty line after each of its four sentences so every sentence stands alone with a blank paragraph following it. Keep every word and the rest of the note unchanged.

states.value:
SITE ARRIVAL SAFETY NOTE
Cedar Point Research Annex | Visitor Orientation
Pause at the marked entry gate. Check in with the floor warden before crossing the service lane. Keep the east stairwell clear for response crews. Report any damaged barrier to the control desk.
WHY THIS MATTERS
The arrival route separates visitors from active deliveries and gives the response team an unobstructed path through the building.
CONTACT
Control desk: +1 555 016 4408 | access@cedarpoint-annex.example
Document control: Safety Office | Orientation note 3.1
